title: Installation problem: Cannot find type definition file for 'googlemaps'
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

Instantsearch.js/es/widgets/geo-search/geosearch.d.ts and Instantsearch.js/es/widgets/geo-search/createHTMLMarker.d.ts both have the following line of code: 
Line 2: `/// <reference types="googlemaps" />`
My IDE gives the following error regarding that line: "Cannot find type definition file for 'googlemaps'" and Angular will give me the same error during an ng serve.

If I attempt to install @types/googlemaps to solve the issue, every declaration it has in common with @types/google.maps get a Duplicate Identifier error. 

Removing the line fixes the issue as a workaround, but it won't be applicable in production. 
This line is also not in your source code, which I'll assume it is generated by something.


### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

Simply download the relevant libraries, start a basic angular project and attempt to launch the front end.
I am sorry, I have not been able to run the codesandbox online, but it worked locally.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/github/Annoxis/instantsearch_googlemaps_import_problem/main?file=%2Fmy-angular-app%2Fpackage-lock.json&workspaceId=7fae891e-38f3-4e2e-9b6a-9d119ae163ab

### 💭 Expected behavior

My front end compile.

### Package version

Instantsearch.js 4.72.1, types/google.maps 3.55.9, angular 17.3.4, npm 10.5.0

### Operating system

Tested under Mac Sonoma and Windows 11 (WSL 2)
